changelog.message: new op for real-time 2D human pose joint tracking using macOS native Apple Vision frameworks
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Tracks 2D human body pose joints and coordinates in real-time from an input WebGL texture using macOS Apple Vision neural frameworks.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native Swift HumanPose2d sidecar process.

ports.name: Render
ports.text: Trigger render loop to process the incoming texture.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: WebGL Texture containing the human subject to track.

ports.name: Poses Array
ports.text: An array of detected poses containing tracked joint names, normalized x/y coordinates (mapped to top-left origin), and confidence levels.

ports.name: Detected Poses
ports.text: Total number of human bodies currently tracked in the active frame.

ports.name: On Poses Detected
ports.text: Trigger fired every time a new set of pose landmarks is received.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native pose detection sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the Swift sidecar process.
